# In-Game Currency (I.K.E.M.E.N. GO Module)

Adds an In-Game Currency System (Player Currency will increase when back to main menu, only if win matchs).

## Installation

Copy the entire `currency` directory into:
`Ikemen_GO/external/mods/`

Ikemen GO will load the module automatically on startup.

## Screenpack / `system.def` defaults

The module includes its own `rewardScreen.def` (next to the script) with **default values for the 720p ikemen1 motif**.

You can leave these defaults in the module or overwrite as your needs.

## Currency Rewards customization

A dedicated rewards:

- victory.reward
- firstattack.reward
- specialko.reward
- superko.reward
- perfectko.reward

are provided in rewardScreen.def file to setup for each victory condition.
